diagnosis.rationale: Direct dilution of the retained 18 h aliquot independently reproduced the undiluted reading. At 10-fold dilution, three reads averaged 0.0974, corresponding to OD600 0.974. At 20-fold dilution, three reads averaged 0.0483, corresponding to OD600 0.966. Both agree closely with the supplied undiluted 18 h reading of 0.964. Thus there is no evidence of late-culture reader saturation or biomass being concealed by the undiluted measurements; the late plateau around 0.93–0.99 is consistent with the measured biomass.
